cur = str(self.session.props.theme or '')
	self.session.props.theme = 'light' if cur.startswith('dark') else 'dark'

# Reseed everything (relative to today) and go home.
	self.session.custom.demo.seeded = False

onChange.script:
# Seed evergreen demo data into session.custom.demo, relative to today, in # the GATEWAY's timezone (ops/demo.sh pins that to the host's zone). Runs on # session start (the binding delivers the initial seeded=False) and again # after "Reset demo" flips it back. val = currentValue.value if currentValue else None if val: return from java.text import SimpleDateFormat from java.util import Calendar, Date fmt = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss") cal = Calendar.getInstance() cal.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0) cal.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0) cal.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0) cal.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0) base = cal.getTimeInMillis() HOUR = 3600000 def at(n, h, m=0): return base + ((n * 24 + h) * 60 + m) * 60000 def iso(ms): return fmt.format(Date(ms)) def day(n): return iso(at(n, 0))[:10] # --- production schedule (resource timeline) --- o = [] def ev(eid, res, title, s, e, cat, **kw): row = {'id': eid, 'resourceId': res, 'title': title, 'start': iso(s), 'category': cat} if e is not None: row['end'] = iso(e) row.update(kw) o.append(row) for n in (-1, 0, 1): p = 'd%d' % (n + 1) ev(p+'m1a', 'm1', 'Brew 4711 - Pils', at(n,6), at(n,10), 'prod') ev(p+'m1b', 'm1', 'Brew 4712 - Wheat', at(n,10,30), at(n,14), 'prod') ev(p+'m1c', 'm1', 'Brew 4713 - IPA', at(n,14,30), at(n,18,30), 'prod') ev(p+'m2a', 'm2', 'Brew 4720 - Lager', at(n,7), at(n,12), 'prod') ev(p+'f1c', 'f1', 'CIP - caustic + rinse', at(n,5), at(n,6,45), 'cip') ev(p+'f1a', 'f1', 'Fill Pils 33cl', at(n,7), at(n,12), 'prod') ev(p+'f1b', 'f1', 'Fill Wheat 50cl', at(n,12,30), at(n,16,30), 'prod') ev(p+'k1a', 'k1', 'Pack order 55212', at(n,8), at(n,13), 'prod') ev(p+'k1b', 'k1', 'Pack order 55219', at(n,13,30), at(n,17), 'prod') ev(p+'f2c', 'f2', 'CIP - caustic + rinse', at(n,4), at(n,5,45), 'cip') ev(p+'f2a', 'f2', 'Fill Lager 50cl PET', at(n,6), at(n,13), 'prod') ev(p+'k2a', 'k2', 'Pack order 55214', at(n,7), at(n,14), 'prod') ev(p+'ca', 'ca', 'Early shift', at(n,6), at(n,14), 'shift') ev(p+'cb', 'cb', 'Late shift', at(n,14), at(n,22), 'shift') ev('rush', 'm2', 'Rush order - Radler', at(0,13), at(0,16), 'prod', status='tentative', description='Awaiting material confirmation from planning.') ev('jam', 'k2', 'Label jam', at(0,9,15), at(0,10), 'down', description='Cleared by the operator; 45 min lost.') ev('wo1', 'mx', 'WO-2231 Filler 2 bearing', at(0,13), at(0,15), 'maint', description='Vibration trending up - swap the bearing cartridge.') ev('wo2', 'mx', 'WO-2228 Conveyor guard', at(-1,9), at(-1,11), 'maint', status='done') ev('bgm', 'k2', 'Planned maintenance window', at(1,14), at(1,17), 'maint', display='background') ev('s1', 'f2', 'RUNNING', at(0,0), at(0,4), 'prod', display='state') ev('s2', 'f2', 'FAULT', at(0,4), at(0,4,45), 'down', display='state') ev('s3', 'f2', 'RUNNING', at(0,4,45), None, 'prod', display='state') orec = [ {'id': 'rh1', 'resourceId': 'ca', 'title': 'Handover', 'start': iso(at(-30,5,45)), 'end': iso(at(-30,6)), 'category': 'shift', 'rrule': {'freq': 'daily'}}, {'id': 'rh2', 'resourceId': 'cb', 'title': 'Handover', 'start': iso(at(-30,13,45)), 'end': iso(at(-30,14)), 'category': 'shift', 'rrule': {'freq': 'daily'}}, ] # --- maintenance calendar --- m = [] def cev(eid, title, n, h1, mi1, h2, mi2, cat, **kw): row = {'id': eid, 'title': title, 'start': iso(at(n,h1,mi1)), 'end': iso(at(n,h2,mi2)), 'category': cat} row.update(kw) m.append(row) cev('pm1', 'PM - Mixer 1 gearbox', -9, 8,0, 12,0, 'pm', status='done') cev('cal1', 'Calibrate flow meters', -6, 9,0, 11,0, 'calib', status='done') cev('ins1', 'Pressure vessel inspection', -3, 13,0, 16,0, 'insp', status='done') cev('pm2', 'PM - Filler 2 bearing swap', 0, 13,0, 15,0, 'pm', description='WO-2231. Coordinate with production; Line 2 is buffered.') cev('cal2', 'Calibrate checkweigher', 1, 9,0, 10,30, 'calib') cev('vnd', 'Vendor visit - seamer OEM', 3, 10,0, 12,0, 'insp', status='cancelled') cev('pm3', 'PM - Packer 1 chains', 8, 6,0, 10,0, 'pm') cev('trn', 'Training - new CIP recipe', 10, 14,0, 16,0, 'train') m.append({'id': 'aud', 'title': 'External audit - ISO 22000', 'start': day(2), 'allDay': True, 'category': 'insp', 'status': 'tentative'}) m.append({'id': 'shut', 'title': 'Annual shutdown - Line 2', 'start': day(4), 'end': day(7), 'allDay': True, 'category': 'shut', 'description': 'Contractors on site. Permit-to-work required.'}) mrec = [ {'id': 'walk', 'title': 'Line walk-down', 'start': iso(at(-28,8,0)), 'end': iso(at(-28,8,30)), 'category': 'insp', 'rrule': {'freq': 'weekly', 'byweekday': [1]}}, {'id': 'saf', 'title': 'Safety committee', 'start': iso(at(-28,15,0)), 'end': iso(at(-28,16,0)), 'category': 'train', 'rrule': {'freq': 'monthly'}}, ] # --- quality samples (deterministic pseudo-random, last 48 h) --- q = [] opnames = ['A. Janssens', 'M. Peeters', 'S. Willems', 'K. De Smet'] prods = [('Pils 33cl', 'Line 1'), ('Wheat 50cl', 'Line 1'), ('Lager 50cl PET', 'Line 2')] nowms = system.date.toMillis(system.date.now()) for i in range(40): ts = nowms - i * 73 * 60000 dev = ((i * 37) % 11) - 5 fill = 500 + dev * 0.6 if i in (3, 11, 26): fill = 500 + (8.5 if i % 2 else -9.2) temp = 3.8 + ((i * 13) % 9) * 0.1 pr = prods[(i * 7) % 3] passed = 495.0 <= fill <= 505.0 q.append({'id': 'S-%04d' % (9000 - i), 'tsMs': ts, 'ts': iso(ts), 'line': pr[1], 'product': pr[0], 'fillMl': round(fill * 10) / 10.0, 'tempC': round(temp * 10) / 10.0, 'passed': passed, 'operator': opnames[(i * 5) % 4], 'note': '' if passed else 'Out of spec - hold pallet'}) # --- shift handover note (rich text) --- hand = (u'

Shift handover - Early to Late

' u'

Line 1 ran at 96% of plan; brew 4712 finished early. ' u'Line 2 lost 45 min to a label jam on Packer 2 (cleared).

' u'

Watch items

    ' u'
  • Filler 2 bearing - vibration trending up, PM planned 13:00 (WO-2231).
    • ' u'
  • CO2 delivery moved to 16:00 - keep an eye on tank level.
' u'

Actions for the late shift

' u'
    ' u'
  • Confirm CIP on Filler 1 completed
    • ' u'
  • Verify label reel splice on Packer 2
    • ' u'
  • Sign off WO-2231 after the bearing swap
    • ' u'
') cfgtxt = ('{\n' ' "plant": "Mustry Bottling Co.",\n' ' "lines": {\n' ' "line1": { "product": "Pils 33cl", "targetBph": 12000, "cip": { "hour": 5, "durationMin": 105 } },\n' ' "line2": { "product": "Lager 50cl PET", "targetBph": 9000, "cip": { "hour": 4, "durationMin": 105 } }\n' ' },\n' ' "quality": { "fillTargetMl": 500, "toleranceMl": 5, "sampleEveryMin": 75 },\n' ' "statusColors": { "running": "#22c55e", "idle": "#f59e0b", "fault": "#ef4444" }\n' '}') d = self.session.custom.demo d.orders = o d.ordersRecurring = orec d.maint = m d.maintRecurring = mrec d.quality = q d.qWindow = {'startMs': nowms - 24 * HOUR, 'endMs': nowms + HOUR} d.handover = hand d.lineConfig = cfgtxt if self.session.props.theme != 'dark': self.session.props.theme = 'dark' d.seeded = True
